questions.question: What's the primary motivation for looking right now?

options.label: More money / financial upside
options.description: Equity, higher comp, or a second income stream are the main drivers.

options.label: More interesting work
options.description: Bored / stagnant at Visa, want to work on something more engaging technically or in domain.

options.label: Better lifestyle / flexibility
options.description: Want fewer hours, remote freedom, less corporate politics, or time for other things.

options.label: Build something of your own again
options.description: Itching to try founding / co-founding / indie-hacking another company or product.

questions.question: IC vs management — what role shape do you actually want next?

options.label: Stay in management / leadership
options.description: EM, Director, Head of Eng — keep building and leading teams.

options.label: Go back to hands-on IC (Senior / Staff / Principal)
options.description: Drop the people-management overhead and write code / architect again.

options.label: Hybrid — tech lead / staff+ with some leadership
options.description: Heavy IC with mentorship, architecture, and influence but not headcount.

options.label: Founder / solo / contractor
options.description: Own your own thing or trade hours for money on your terms.

questions.question: What part-time/contract realities apply to you?

options.label: Visa job is staying — need side work that fits around it
Open to leaving Visa for the right thing
options.description: Full-time switch is on the table if the opportunity is right.

options.label: Want fully remote
options.description: Geography-independent only — no commute, no relocation.

options.label: US work authorization / visa-sponsored
options.description: Constrains which employers can hire you (relevant for contract gigs especially).

questions.question: Which of your past skill areas do you actually want to keep using?

options.label: Big data / data platforms / data engineering
options.description: Your Visa-era work — Spark, pipelines, warehousing, ML infra.

options.label: Backend / distributed systems / payments
options.description: Server-side, APIs, payments-domain expertise from Visa.

options.label: Something newer — AI/ML, LLM apps, agentic systems
options.description: Pivot toward the current AI wave (where most hiring + funding is right now).

transcript_tail.text: So the objective of this project is actually to help me find out what to do next in my career. I am a software engineer, uh, am… engineering manager at Visa. Uh, before, I worked on startups. I have worked on different things like CAD for microelectronics. I have worked with, um, mobile apps. I had tried my own company. And at Visa, I have worked with, uh, big data, uh, and mobile apps. Um, I worked on startup before Visa. Um, so I’m looking for ideas for either part time or full time, um, using my skills, uh, as an software engineer, mostly a senior software engineer.

Got it — saved your background to memory so I have it for next time. To point you somewhere useful instead of giving generic suggestions, a few things make a big difference. Let me ask the most important ones.

expected.rec_session: Better lifestyle / flexibility, More interesting work, Hybrid or lead, Open to leaving Visa for the right thing, Something newer — AI/ML, LLM apps, agentic systems
